name.description: The name of the theme set.

themes.description: The theme list of the theme set.

is_default.description: Whether this theme is the default theme.

mode.description: The mode of the theme, default is light.

font.size.description: The base font size, default is 16.

font.family.description: The base font family, default is system font: `.SystemUIFont`.

mono_font.family.description:
The monospace font family, default is platform specific:
- macOS: `Menlo`
- Windows: `Consolas`
- Linux: `DejaVu Sans Mono`

mono_font.size.description: The monospace font size, default is 13.

radius.description: The border radius for general elements, default is 6.

radius.lg.description: The border radius for large elements like Dialogs and Notifications, default is 8.

shadow.description: Set shadows in the theme, for example the Input and Button, default is true.

highlight.description:
The highlight theme, this part is combilbility with `style` section in Zed theme.

https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/blob/f50041779dcfd7a76c8aec293361c60c53f02d51/assets/themes/ayu/ayu.json#L9

accent.background.description: Used for accents such as hover background on MenuItem, ListItem, etc.

button.danger.background.description: Button danger background color, fallback to `danger`.

button.danger.active.background.description: Button danger active background color, fallback to `danger_active`.

button.danger.foreground.description: Button danger text color, fallback to `danger_foreground`.

button.danger.hover.background.description: Button danger hover background color, fallback to `danger_hover`.

button.info.background.description: Button info background color, fallback to `info`.

button.info.active.background.description: Button info active background color, fallback to `info_active`.

button.info.foreground.description: Button info text color, fallback to `info_foreground`.

button.info.hover.background.description: Button info hover background color, fallback to `info_hover`.

button.primary.background.description: Button primary background color, fallback to `primary`.

button.primary.active.background.description: Button primary active background color, fallback to `primary_active`.

button.primary.foreground.description: Button primary text color, fallback to `primary_foreground`.

button.primary.hover.background.description: Button primary hover background color, fallback to `primary_hover`.

button.secondary.background.description: Button secondary background color, fallback to `secondary`.

button.secondary.active.background.description: Button secondary active background color, fallback to `secondary_active`.

button.secondary.foreground.description: Button secondary text color, fallback to `secondary_foreground`.

button.secondary.hover.background.description: Button secondary hover background color, fallback to `secondary_hover`.

button.success.background.description: Button success background color, fallback to `success`.

button.success.active.background.description: Button success active background color, fallback to `success_active`.

button.success.foreground.description: Button success text color, fallback to `success_foreground`.

button.success.hover.background.description: Button success hover background color, fallback to `success_hover`.

button.warning.background.description: Button warning background color, fallback to `warning`.

button.warning.active.background.description: Button warning active background color, fallback to `warning_active`.

button.warning.foreground.description: Button warning text color, fallback to `warning_foreground`.

button.warning.hover.background.description: Button warning hover background color, fallback to `warning_hover`.

chart_bullish.description: Bullish color for candlestick charts (upward price movement).

chart_bearish.description: Bearish color for candlestick charts (downward price movement).

input.border.description: Border color for inputs such as Input, Select, etc.

list.background.description: Background color for List and ListItem.

list.even.background.description: Stripe background color for even ListItem.

muted.background.description: Muted backgrounds such as Skeleton and Switch.

muted.foreground.description: Muted text color, as used in disabled text.

secondary.foreground.description: Secondary text color, used for secondary Button text color or secondary text.

table.even.background.description: Stripe background color for even TableRow.

title_bar.background.description: TitleBar background color, use for Window title bar.

status_bar.background.description: StatusBar background color, use for the bottom status bar.

window.border.description:
Window border color.

# Platform specific:

This is only works on Linux, other platforms we can't change the window border color.

border.strong.description: Strong border color for emphasized outlines and drop zones.

waveform.time_selection.foreground.description: Waveform fill inside a time selection.

waveform.overlay.fill.description: Waveform fill over a visual overlay.

waveform.overlay.time_selection.foregrou.description: Selected waveform fill over a visual overlay.
